AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: abyssal signal interpretation
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony learns to treat abyssal noise as an addressable response pattern rather than a random anomaly. This is the first safe vocabulary of the Protocol.

unlocks.li: Marks the first contact layer as understood.
Keeps early Forge hints legible.

notes.li: Auto-decoded once vanilla research prerequisites are met.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: primitive breach protocols
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The first repeatable low-risk breach procedures. These protocols keep early summons small enough to be used as controlled contact rather than uncontrolled invasion.

unlocks.li: Reveals primitive breach and low-tier sigil families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: residue recognition
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony identifies Infernal Residue as the material shadow of contact: unstable, valuable and dangerous enough to become an industrial reagent.

unlocks.li: Reveals the earliest residue handling vocabulary.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: forge contact vocabulary
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The Abyssal Forge begins to classify shapes, outputs and unsafe production signatures without yet understanding their full functions.

unlocks.li: Allows the Forge to display unknown pattern families instead of hiding them.

notes.li: Auto-decoded. This is the bridge between Nexus and Forge cards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: circle stabilizer frames
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Basic stabilizer frames teach the colony to hold a breach in a repeatable geometry long enough for practical ritual use.

unlocks.li: Reveals early stabilizer/module infrastructure.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: ashbound capacitance
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The first abyssal capacitors store ritual pressure as a controlled industrial load instead of a map-scale accident waiting to happen.

unlocks.li: Reveals ashbound capacitor and early energy support patterns.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: residue processing
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Residue stops being a trophy and becomes a processed reagent for repeatable Forge recipes, early modules and ritual-support materials.

unlocks.li: Reveals early core/resource recipes.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: basic abyssal arms
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The first weapon patterns translate residue pressure into blades, pistols, repeaters and other battlefield-readable forms.

unlocks.li: Reveals early weapon cards in the Forge.

notes.li: One project unlocks a family, not one item.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: ashbound combat kit
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Early protective equipment teaches pawns to survive contact residue without pretending it is normal armor material.

unlocks.li: Reveals early armor/apparel cards.

notes.li: One project unlocks a family, not one item.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: rift ballistics
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Rift weapons throw shaped disagreements into armor and tissue. This project classifies their stable combat roles.

unlocks.li: Reveals rift carbines, needlers and related mid-tier weapons.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: null geometry handling
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony learns to survive and weaponize absence: null pressure, anti-aura logic and geometry that interrupts normal targeting assumptions.

unlocks.li: Reveals null weapon and null-field pattern families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: basic abyssal implants
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The Protocol moves from external machines into colonist biology. Early implants are controlled compromises with the body.

unlocks.li: Reveals early implant procedures.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: abyssal armor systems
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Abyssal armor becomes more than plating: it is a wearable method for remaining coherent under hostile breach pressure.

unlocks.li: Reveals mid-tier armor and accessories.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: elite summoning patterns
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony stops calling mass and begins calling function: snipers, brutes, priests, relay nodes and specialized threats.

unlocks.li: Reveals elite encounter and mid-tier sigil families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: core integration
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: A core is not a battery. It is a functioning organ of the external system, and integrating it makes the colony part of that system.

unlocks.li: Reveals core-powered implants and mid-tier production requirements.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: modular turret interface
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The first turret modules translate breach logic into slots, targeting states and controlled automated defense.

unlocks.li: Reveals basic modular turret chassis/modules.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: archon sigil handling
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: An archon sigil is a recorded permission event, not a trophy. This project teaches the colony to store and reproduce that right safely.

unlocks.li: Reveals archon and boss-gated invocation rights.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: major boss invocation
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: A major boss invocation is not a stronger summon. It is a formal request for a domain-bearing authority to answer the colony directly.

unlocks.li: Reveals Reactor Saint and major-boss invocation families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crown logic decoding
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony begins to read Crown Shards as fragments of administrative authority rather than high-grade loot.

unlocks.li: Reveals crown-tier Forge logic and late resource recipes.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: heavy infernal systems
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony stops adapting weapons and begins fielding mobile breach machinery: heavy guns, boss-breakers and siege-grade conduits.

unlocks.li: Reveals heavy infernal and anti-fortification weapons.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: advanced implants
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Advanced implants treat the pawn as a compatible platform for alien command pressure rather than a patient receiving surgery.

unlocks.li: Reveals advanced implant procedures.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: gatebreaker carapace logic
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Gatebreaker doctrine treats armor as a response to boss arenas, anchors and prolonged breach exposure rather than only bullets and claws.

unlocks.li: Reveals Gatebreaker and Saint-resistant armor families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: breach lockdown systems
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Advanced turret modules learn to hold breach states in place: lances, arcs, harpoons, null pressure and siege lockdown roles.

unlocks.li: Reveals advanced turret module families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion gate bootstrapping
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The circle lattice is hardened for Dominion-class synchronization: not a final gate, but the first serious attempt to enter hostile infrastructure.

unlocks.li: Reveals Dominion entry preparation and Hell-tier routing.

notes.li: Tier V is Hell/Dominion Slice, not Final Gate.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion slice cartography
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony learns to read the Dominion Slice as a hostile industrial map rather than a random hell biome.

unlocks.li: Frames Dominion terrain, pockets, approach vectors and map hazards.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell UI/lore.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: infernal pocket stabilization
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Pocket stabilization keeps entry, exit, transfer and collapse states legible enough to survive the trip into Hell.

unlocks.li: Reveals pocket runtime, exit handling and Dominion transition support.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell infrastructure.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: anchor-law breach analysis
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Dominion anchors are not props. They are local law fasteners that teach the player how Hell resists extraction.

unlocks.li: Frames Dominion anchors, heart pressure and collapse mechanics.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell encounters.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion survival frames
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Dominion survival frames are built for maps that no longer behave like ordinary RimWorld spaces.

unlocks.li: Reveals Dominion survival armor and Crowned Core defensive patterns.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell rewards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crowned core extraction
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony learns to extract and stabilize Dominion-grade authority fragments without mistaking them for ordinary boss drops.

unlocks.li: Reveals Crowned Core, Dominion Crown Shard and Hell-tier reward processing.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell rewards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: dominion biology
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The body is prepared for Dominion law: implants, organs and survival logic made from Hell exposure rather than ordinary surgery.

unlocks.li: Reveals Dominion implant families.

notes.li: Real decode project for Hell rewards.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: final gate architecture
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Final Gate Architecture is the step beyond Hell-entry: designing the encounter as an enemy infrastructure rather than a place.

unlocks.li: Frames future Final Gate access.

notes.li: Future reserve. Current playable scope mostly ends before this.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crowned gate invocation
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony attempts to address an enemy infrastructure as an encounter: gate, anchors, waves and command pressure as one hostile machine.

unlocks.li: Frames future Crowned Gate encounter access.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: apex weaponry
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Apex weapons are designed to be legally meaningful against entities whose bodies are only interfaces.

unlocks.li: Frames future apex weapon gates.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: crownfire / sepulcher calibration
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Final anti-boss turret systems require Crownfire, Sepulcher and prism logic calibrated against domain-scale targets.

unlocks.li: Frames final turret systems.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: heraldic fragment analysis
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: Some fragments are not trophies. They are messages, addresses and permissions left by entities speaking from higher invasion layers.

unlocks.li: Frames Herald weapons and fragment interpretation.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: oblivion choir interface
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The Herald layer becomes audible as command music: crownspikes, stormcasters and choir-grade weapons that answer to something above bosses.

unlocks.li: Frames future Herald combat families.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: schism cartography / godshard forensics
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: The colony maps a conflict above the known Abyss: schism traces, godshards and severance logic that do not belong to normal demons.

unlocks.li: Frames future schism, godshard and severance systems.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.label: interface beyond the gate
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_ProtocolResearchDef.description: A final forbidden hypothesis: even godlike entities may be only the last readable interface of something without throne, face or ending.

unlocks.li: Frames ultimate continuation hook and hidden endgame reserve.
